Moy kʷékʷlos h₁ésti. Tóm toy dídoh₃mi.
English: I have a wheel. I give it to you.

Swéḱure, tóm wiHróm ne léykʷoh₂. H₂ówim pékʷoh₂.
English: Father-in-law, I do not leave the man. I am cooking a sheep.

Ph₂tḗr h₂éǵroy h₁ésti.
English: Father is in the field.

Ǵʰáysom dʰéh₁m̥.
English: I made the spear.

Gʰóstis dʰwéri stísteh₂ti.
English: A guest is standing at the door.

H₂ówins h₂éǵroy dr̥ḱóm.
English: I saw the sheep in the field.

H₁n̥gʷnís dʰégʷʰeti.
English: The fire is burning.

Wésu! H₁éḱwos h₁sús h₁ésti.
English: Good! The horse is good.

Éy h₂wĺ̥h₂neh₂ méh₂trs h₁ésti.
English: This wool is mother's.

Twóy dómey h₁édmi píph₃oh₂-kʷe.
English: I eat and drink in your house.

Péḱu h₂éǵroy h₁ésti.
English: The flock is in the field.

Só póntoh₂s h₃réǵos dómom h₁éyti.
English: That road goes to the king's house.

Ph₂ter, dwóh₁ gʷówh₁e h₂érh₃troy yunégmi.
English: Father, I am yoking the two cattle to the plough.

Ph₂ter, sóh₂wl̥ wéḱperi úpo dʰéǵʰōm h₁éyti.
English: Father, in the evening the sun goes under the earth.

tód = this (acc.sg.n.); ḱeḱluwṓs = having heard (perf.act.ptcp.nom.sg.m.); h₂ówis = sheep (nom.sg.); h₂aǵróm = plain, field (acc.sg.); bʰugét = fled (aor.3sg.)

H₂ówis h₁éḱwōs-kʷe
h₂ówis = sheep (nom.sg.); h₁éḱwōs = horses (nom.pl.); -kʷe = and
Tói h₁éḱwōs wewkʷónt: «Ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! Tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméi ḱḗr ágʰnutor: h₂nḗr, pótis, h₂ówyom h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ gʷʰormóm wéstrom swébʰi kʷr̥néuti. Néǵʰi h₂ówyom h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ h₁ésti.»
Úpo h₃rḗḱs deywóm Wérunom sesole nú deywóm h₁iyaǵeto.
Ǵʰutḗr tom h₃rḗǵm̥ wéwkʷet: «Íyaǵesuo deywóm Wérunom.»
Akvāsas ā vavakant: krudhi avai, kard aghnutai vividvant-svas: manus patis varnām avisāms karnauti svabhjam gharmam vastram avibhjams ka varnā na asti.
H₃ówis h₁éḱwobʰos éwewkʷet: ḱḗr h₂ǵʰnutoi moi, widn̥tí wiróm h₁éḱwons h₂éǵontm̥.
H₁éḱwōs tu wewkʷond: "Ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! Tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméi h₂égʰnutor ḱḗr: h₂nḗr, pótis, h₂ówyom r̥ wl̥h₂néh₂m̥ sebʰí gʷʰérmom wéstrom kʷr̥néuti. Néǵʰi h₂ówyom wl̥h₂néh₂ h₁ésti."
